notes:
CRM notes (shorthand):
- Enterprise logistics customer, heavy regional routing, high sensitivity to p99 latency spikes.
- Primary workload: ETA forecasting + document ingestion + agent chat for ops desk.
- Wanted 24/7 dedicated pool with predictable burst. Asking for 99.95% uptime minimum or equivalent credit schedule.
- Legal pushing back on credit caps; procurement wants clear formula that ties credits to number of affected requests, not just percentage.
- Security: Okta SSO, customer-managed KMS, 3-year retention for audit logs in-region (US-West).
- Ops: prefer maintenance windows Friday 02:00-05:00 PT; want max 6 events / year.
- Support: require P1 response <= 1 hour, P2 <= 4 hours, escalation path to on-call infra lead.
- Pricing sensitivity: prefers committed monthly GPU pool + capped egress; interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce unit token cost.

proposed_sla_terms: Uptime: 99.95% monthly for Dedicated pool (measured at region/service level)
Credit schedule: 5% monthly credit for 99.90-99.95%, 10% for 99.75-99.90%, 20% for <99.75% (applied to monthly fee)
Scheduled maintenance: 3x windows/year included; additional windows billed or require 30-day notice; default weekly maintenance avoided
Maintenance window timing: customer-preferred Fri 02:00-05:00 PT (max 6 events/year with notice)
Support SLA: P1 acknowledgement <= 1 hour, P1 P2 tracking + causal RCA within 72 hours, on-call escalation route to SE and infra lead
Performance SLOs: 95th percentile inference latency <= 120ms for small-chat requests (<=256 tokens) under reserved throughput
Throughput guarantee: baseline 1200 tokens/sec sustained aggregate for reserved 8-GPU pool; burst to 2400 tokens/sec for 15 minutes
Capacity addendum: ability to reserve incremental GPUs on 30-day notice at pre-negotiated rates
Data controls: audit log retention 3 years, support for customer KMS and VPC peering, SOC2 attestation to be provided
Termination/credits: credits limited to 50% of monthly fee per incident cycle; cumulative cap 100%/month; disputes routed to senior account manager
reserved_capacity_plan: Initial commitment: 8xA100-equivalent GPUs dedicated (single AZ) - provisioned as Dedicated pool
Target steady-state throughput: 80 concurrent inference streams avg, 95th pct latency target <=120ms per request
Burst policy: 2x burst capacity for 15 min windows automatically via reserved burst buffer; additional burst requests routed to compatible model variant
Autoscaling: manual scale-up with 30-day notice for additional reserved GPUs; short-term scaling via burst only
Failover: cross-region failover possible but excluded from base SLA; addendum required for cross-region uptime guarantees
Testing/benchmarks: Redwood to run acceptance tests pre-cutover and provide deterministic perf reports (load profile included in drive doc)
Onboarding milestones: sandbox perf test -> POC (30 days) -> baseline provisioning -> production cutover (target 60 days from signature)
